function host_matvec!(values,idx,cols,x,y)
 # OriginalactiveHYPREalpha1/beta0,singlevector/fullrowbranch; CPUexecutionretained.

function host_axpy!(x,y)

end
function host_matvec_batch!(V,I,J,x,y)

end
function host_axpy_batch!(x,y)

  if y+1<NY;neighbors+=u[i+NX+17];deg+=1;end
  if z+1<NZ;neighbors+=u[i+NX*NY+17];deg+=1;end
  residual=max(residual,abs(6*a-neighbors-(6-deg))/w[i+1])
 end
 (finite=finite,range=range,unweighted=unweighted,weighted=weighted,residual=residual)
end

ROI_membership_proof.timer_to_dispatch_explanation: Selected bh_study/Case.run full octree pipeline is called after case reset and timer start, followed by device completion. Initialization belongs inside run, then each requested step dispatches bbox,clear1,tree-build,clear2,summarize,sort,force,integrate. Cases use(256,1),(256,3),(1024,1),(1024,3),(2048,1); warmup calls same run outside trials. All nine source families are timed members, including integer tree setup.
ROI_membership_proof.precision_branch_atomic_integer_context: Positions/mass/velocity/acceleration use Float32/float4, while topology/child/count/sort/step and atomicCAS/add/sub/inc counters are Int32/UInt32. Tree readiness/locks, volatile loads, barriers, warp votes/shuffles and rsqrt are explicit backend operations. Force distinguishes leaf vs opening-threshold tests and step>0 velocity correction; integration uses the source Float32 dt/halfdt. Scalar add/mul/FMA counters exclude integer, atomic/control and SFU costs.
ROI_membership_proof.reset_setup_and_audit_boundary: External position/velocity/acceleration copies and allocation-guard setup precede timers. Internal clear/init/tree construction are inside. Full state readback, topology/permutation/root-mass checks, independent force comparison and guards/artifacts occur after completion. Raw topology uniqueness or whole-workflow bottlenecks are not inferred.
